rationale: Both candidates found the substance of the sole ground-truth concern (trust_remote_code/kernels-0.13.x compatibility), correctly noting it was already resolved by a later commit and flagging the resulting stale PR description. Y is more concise with less redundancy and includes a genuinely novel, empirically-verified catch (bare get_kernel() call is dead code on kernels>=0.15, confirmed by running against the installed package) that X missed entirely. X is broader and more actionable (ready-to-paste test code, exhaustive file:line evidence) but pads its output with several near-duplicate trust_remote_code entries in the validated section, diluting signal-to-noise.
